title: 2126 Prairie's finished front gains its pilasters, panels and gate piers
items: The completed Robbins house (open it with ?structure=robbins_house_2126_prairie&version=completed on the 1904 scene) now carries what its May 1905 photograph shows: four Ionic pilaster heads under the entablature, marble panels between the storeys with a carved one over the door, keyed lintels, scrolled stone stops at both corners, and brick gate piers topped with balls.
Its photograph is matched from a solved camera; the roofline, the door's side lights and the small-paned sash still differ and are listed on its record.
